item.text: {"0":"For all four datasets, change only the tied item embedding initialization from Normal(0,1) to Normal(0,0.1), with padding row zero. Smaller initial item norms should reduce saturated BCE logits and improve early gradient quality while preserving shared input/output embeddings and the existing dot-product scorer. Keep positional embeddings, SASRec topology, features, history, loss, optimizer, sampling and training schedule fixed. Train one independent model per category; preserve routing and ensure the predictor writer loads the same embedding implementation."}
